slug: 2025-09-24 Morocco fast-tracks 'Mon e-ID' digital identity after cyberattacks (iDAKTO)

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that the Mon e-ID mobile app and citizen portal are in use, with 2.5 million active users and over 7 million digital-identity transactions since April 2022 according to DGSN.
Biometric Update reports that the ministries of Justice, Habitat and Youth, CNSS, DGI and TGR have adopted Mon e-ID, with banks and telecoms following.
Biometric Update reports that the Mon e-ID mobile app lets citizens use their digital identity, with native device biometrics for 1:1 verification and 2.5 million active users per DGSN.

systems.platform: iDAKTO with Idemia Smart Identity by IN Group
